recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the remaining FHIR-37673 behavior in the active operation source without duplicating the already-published related FHIR-22105 and FHIR-37674 reconciliations.
issue_request: FHIR-37673 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that $preferred-id avoid retired NamingSystem resources, add a date input rather than a period input, handle multiple preferred matches by returning all or an error, and note that preferred identifiers for the same identifier type should not overlap by period.
initial_application: The historical FHIR-37673 commit added the date parameter, multiple-preferred footer wording, and the NamingSystem.uniqueId.type period-overlap note. Later related reconciliation commits for FHIR-22105 and FHIR-37674 fixed the period-aware nsd-2 invariant and aligned the operation comment, but the current operation source still omitted the active-status rule, still described only two inputs, and still made the result output single-cardinality.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini and the NamingSystem operations list includes OperationDefinition/NamingSystem-preferred-id, so the edited operation definition is in build scope. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-07-18 confirm accepting the retired-status bullet and adding a date parameter instead of period. Related FHIR-22105 and FHIR-37674 are already represented on the combined branch and were treated as context rather than republished.
reconciliation: Updated source/namingsystem/operationdefinition-NamingSystem-preferred-id.xml so the footer, description, and OperationDefinition.comment state that $preferred-id SHOULD only consider NamingSystem instances with status active; the description now lists the optional date input; and the result output max is repeatable to match the approved option to return all applicable identifiers.
